newsitem.title: ROMANIA: HANDBALL-THIEVES STEAL ROMANIAN CHAMPION'S MEDALS.
newsitem.headline: HANDBALL-THIEVES STEAL ROMANIAN CHAMPION'S MEDALS.

text.p: Thieves broke into Romanian former handball world champion Victorita Dumitrescu's apartment and stole her three gold medals, the daily Evenimentul Zilei reported on Wednesday.
"The thieves appeared to have keys to the Bucharest apartment and clearly knew where the medals where," the newspaper said of the break-in on Monday. "They left everything else in place."
Dumitrescu, 60, was three times world champion with the Romanian national women's team, in 1956, 1960 and 1962.
"This is the hardest blow of my entire life," Dumitrescu told the newspaper.
